title: Invisible Snowball
description: Remove snowball texture without removing anything other
body:
# Snowball Texture Remover (Anti-Lag Pack)
A lightweight optimization resource pack designed to eliminate client-side lag, FPS drops, and crashes caused by excessive snowball entities and lag machines.
## Why Use This Pack?
  When a Minecraft client is forced to render hundreds or thousands of entities simultaneously, it puts a massive strain on your computer's GPU and CPU. Malicious players often exploit this mechanic using "snowball lag machines" to intentionally drop your frame rate, freeze your game, or crash your client completely.
  This texture pack protects your game by completely removing the snowball texture, giving you several key advantages:
- Immunity to Snowball Lag Machines:
Prevents malicious setups from overloading your game client with thousands of moving textures.
Escape "Crash Loops" and Lag Zones:
-  If you get trapped in an area that instantly disconnects or crashes you upon logging in, enabling this pack allows you to successfully reconnect, bypass the rendering overload, and safely move your character away from the lag source.
Farm and Redstone Optimization:
-  Significantly reduces performance hiccups caused by high-efficiency snowball farms or complex redstone mechanisms utilizing snowballs.
### Installation & Configuration
Download the texture pack .zip file and place it into your Minecraft resourcepacks folder.
In-game, go to Options > Resource Packs and move this pack to the top of your selected list.

**Critical Step:** Go to your Video Settings / Graphics Settings and reduce your Particle settings. Combining this pack with decreased particles improves overall lag reduction by an additional 25%.
